summary: Production-readiness testing complete for Swift FX Signals backend. All 7 mandatory fixes verified: (1) Google mock expiry removed, (2) APPLE_ENVIRONMENT no default, (3) MongoDB-based entitlement resolution, (4) MongoDB indexes on startup, (5) Clean CORS config, (6) No empty-string env fallbacks, (7) /api/health endpoint. 17/17 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Fix #1: Google verify endpoint correctly rejects if no expiryTimeMillis (line 6487-6491)
✅ Fix #2: APPLE_ENVIRONMENT has no default value, uses os.environ.get('APPLE_ENVIRONMENT') only (line 44)
✅ Fix #2: APPLE_ENVIRONMENT validation present - must be 'sandbox', 'production', or None (lines 45-46)
✅ Fix #3: get_effective_subscription() uses MongoDB iap_transactions as single source of truth (lines 385-432)
✅ Fix #4: MongoDB indexes created on startup for iap_transactions, signals, device_tokens, ai_analyses, posts, support_tickets (lines 3169-3178)
✅ Fix #5: CORS uses CORS_ORIGINS env var - no hardcoded localhost or preview URLs (lines 7051-7055)
✅ Fix #6: supabase_auth.py raises ValueError if SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY not set (lines 14-15)
✅ Admin user correctly has is_admin=true with VIP-level signal access
